item.title: Fast Inference Diffusion Policy for Robot Ball Catching Task
item.description: Developed a diffusion-based imitation learning framework with probabilistic dynamic movement primitives that distills multi-step denoising into a single-step inference process, enabling fast action generation and validated on a robotic ball-catching task.

item.title: Pi0.5 with Spatial Module
item.description: Vision-language-action model (Pi0.5) integrated with spatial module, designed with causal attention and mixture-of-expert mechanism. Testing the model in Libero Spatial environment.
